hero.heading: Growing Gardens Growing Communities
hero.missionText: To provide opportunities for local residents to garden, grow, and harvest produce, to promote education about sustainable local food production and gardening techniques as well as offer educational workshops for all ages on topics such as nutrition and healthy food preparation.

featureCards.title: Community Gardens
featureCards.description: Growing in partnership at 2 Gardens: Hope Family Health (a nonprofit qualified health center), and Small Wonders Farm School.

featureCards.title: Education
featureCards.description: In 2024–2025, we hosted 10 free hands-on classes on growing food, preserving it, and saving seeds.

featureCards.title: Community
featureCards.description: Since 2024, we’ve brought people together through seed swaps, a plant swap, the Tomato Festival, and a community vision meeting.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide opportunities for local residents to garden, grow, and harvest produce, to promote education about sustainable local food production and gardening techniques as well as offer educational workshops for all ages on topics such as nutrition and healthy food preparation.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.text: We envision a city where every neighborhood has access to community gardens, where sustainable gardening practices are widely understood and practiced, and where communities are strengthened through shared experiences of growing food together.

cards.title: Community First
cards.description: We believe that strong communities are built through shared experiences and mutual support. Our gardens are spaces where neighbors become friends.

cards.title: Sustainability
cards.description: We practice and teach environmentally responsible gardening methods that protect our soil, water, and ecosystems for future generations.

cards.title: Accessibility
cards.description: Everyone should have access to fresh produce and green spaces. We work to remove barriers and create inclusive garden communities.

cards.title: Education
cards.description: We believe in lifelong learning and sharing knowledge. Our workshops and programs welcome gardeners of all skill levels.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.text: Have questions about ReGarden or want to get involved? We'd love to hear from you!

quote.text: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.

joinOurTeam.heading: Join Our Team
joinOurTeam.text: Interested in joining ReGarden? We're always looking for passionate individuals to help us grow our impact. Check out our volunteer opportunities or contact us about employment opportunities.

volunteer.subtitle: No experience necessary—we'll teach you everything you need to know!
volunteer.description: Volunteers are the heart of ReGarden. Join us in creating and maintaining community gardens, organizing events, and growing a stronger community together.

cards.title: Education & Events

cards.title: Community Leadership

howDonationHelps.heading: How Your Donation Helps
howDonationHelps.description: Your donation helps us maintain community gardens, provide educational workshops, and create accessible green spaces for everyone. Every contribution makes a difference in growing a stronger, greener community.
